**STEP 6 - Grams:** Cut fruit bulk density ≈ 0.6 g/ml, so 115 ml × 0.6 ≈ 70 g. This matches 14 pieces at about 5 g each.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Fresh pineapple ≈ 50 kcal/100 g, so 70 g × 0.5 ≈ 35 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A small pile of about 14 chunks covering about an eighth of a dinner plate should weigh well under 100 g. About 70 g and 35 kcal is plausible.
